context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin flow validated: 17 clinical fields present, package toggle works, package load failure blocks save then refresh recovers, modal package start_date defaults to visit date, modal-created package persists independently, and retry-same-save reuses exact payload with legacy monetary fields zeroed in package mode.
